units.rawText: Croque? Croque?
units.displayText: Croque? Croque?

spans.text: Croque? Croque?

units.rawText: I looked around for Croque at the festival, but she was not so easily found.
units.displayText: I looked around for Croque at the festival, but she was not so easily found.

spans.text: I looked around for Croque at the festival, but she was not so easily found.

units.rawText: And I wanted to give her the envelope I had ready... hm?
units.displayText: And I wanted to give her the envelope I had ready... hm?

spans.text: And I wanted to give her the envelope I had ready... hm?

units.rawText: Klik, klik, klik.
units.displayText: Klik, klik, klik.

spans.text: Klik, klik, klik.

units.rawText: What's that noise?
units.displayText: What's that noise?

spans.text: What's that noise?

units.rawText: Boo!
units.displayText: Boo!

spans.text: Boo!

units.rawText: A brand new animal-like mecha appears out of nowhere, prancing around me in a joyous fashion. Beside it is a figure, obviously excited.
units.displayText: A brand new animal-like mecha appears out of nowhere, prancing around me in a joyous fashion. Beside it is a figure, obviously excited.

spans.text: A brand new animal-like mecha appears out of nowhere, prancing around me in a joyous fashion. Beside it is a figure, obviously excited.

units.rawText: Professor, look! My newest creation!
units.displayText: Professor, look! My newest creation!

spans.text: Professor, look! My newest creation!

units.rawText: And I was wondering where you were. To think of it, shouldn't this mecha be on display?
units.displayText: And I was wondering where you were. To think of it, shouldn't this mecha be on display?

spans.text: And I was wondering where you were. To think of it, shouldn't this mecha be on display?

units.rawText: Hehe, this Mecha-Beast is on a completely different level! I present to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA!
units.displayText: Hehe, this Mecha-Beast is on a completely different level! I present to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA!

spans.text: Hehe, this Mecha-Beast is on a completely different level! I present to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA!

units.rawText: A smaller chassis, and more flexible joints within the existing framework.
units.displayText: A smaller chassis, and more flexible joints within the existing framework.

spans.text: A smaller chassis, and more flexible joints within the existing framework.

units.rawText: In combination with the flexibility afforded by a brand-new alloy and a new system of layered plating, this baby has three times the mobility of the original "Nian"!
units.displayText: In combination with the flexibility afforded by a brand-new alloy and a new system of layered plating, this baby has three times the mobility of the original "Nian"!

spans.text: In combination with the flexibility afforded by a brand-new alloy and a new system of layered plating, this baby has three times the mobility of the original "Nian"!

units.rawText: Ah! Nothing short of a masterpiece!
units.displayText: Ah! Nothing short of a masterpiece!

spans.text: Ah! Nothing short of a masterpiece!

options.rawText: To add NOVA onto the end of something's second generation... the exact same as the original work, huh?
options.displayText: To add NOVA onto the end of something's second generation... the exact same as the original work, huh?

spans.text: To add NOVA onto the end of something's second generation... the exact same as the original work, huh?

options.rawText: Adding an English word after "Nian"... seems a little out of place, doesn't it?
options.displayText: Adding an English word after "Nian"... seems a little out of place, doesn't it?

spans.text: Adding an English word after "Nian"... seems a little out of place, doesn't it?

units.rawText: Hehehe, I would expect nothing less from the Professor. This NOVA here takes on the very soul of the first generation of Super Mecha-Beasts!
units.displayText: Hehehe, I would expect nothing less from the Professor. This NOVA here takes on the very soul of the first generation of Super Mecha-Beasts!

spans.text: Hehehe, I would expect nothing less from the Professor. This NOVA here takes on the very soul of the first generation of Super Mecha-Beasts!

units.rawText: I'll have you know this is perfectly normal and accepted for mechas! G, NOVA, S, Z, and MK2 are all commonplace.
units.displayText: I'll have you know this is perfectly normal and accepted for mechas! G, NOVA, S, Z, and MK2 are all commonplace.

spans.text: I'll have you know this is perfectly normal and accepted for mechas! G, NOVA, S, Z, and MK2 are all commonplace.

units.rawText: Next we'll need a mass-production model, and an improved model...
units.displayText: Next we'll need a mass-production model, and an improved model...

spans.text: Next we'll need a mass-production model, and an improved model...

units.rawText: And then we can say the famous words—"Humanity is doomed to repeat its mistakes!"
units.displayText: And then we can say the famous words—"Humanity is doomed to repeat its mistakes!"

spans.text: And then we can say the famous words—"Humanity is doomed to repeat its mistakes!"

units.rawText: That battle with the first iteration of the mecha hasn't diminished your spirit one bit, has it?
units.displayText: That battle with the first iteration of the mecha hasn't diminished your spirit one bit, has it?

spans.text: That battle with the first iteration of the mecha hasn't diminished your spirit one bit, has it?

units.rawText: Hehehe, facing off with one's own creations and the losses associated with that are part of the charm. Iterations upon models are the very essence of a mecha, after all!
units.displayText: Hehehe, facing off with one's own creations and the losses associated with that are part of the charm. Iterations upon models are the very essence of a mecha, after all!

spans.text: Hehehe, facing off with one's own creations and the losses associated with that are part of the charm. Iterations upon models are the very essence of a mecha, after all!

units.rawText: Takes one's mind back to that classic scene—under the setting sun, the original model falls silent in the arms of the second generation... what romance!
units.displayText: Takes one's mind back to that classic scene—under the setting sun, the original model falls silent in the arms of the second generation... what romance!

spans.text: Takes one's mind back to that classic scene—under the setting sun, the original model falls silent in the arms of the second generation... what romance!

units.rawText: And... it fulfilled its mission at the end, no?
units.displayText: And... it fulfilled its mission at the end, no?

spans.text: And... it fulfilled its mission at the end, no?

units.rawText: Thinking back to that beautiful display, I can't help but smile.
units.displayText: Thinking back to that beautiful display, I can't help but smile.

spans.text: Thinking back to that beautiful display, I can't help but smile.

units.rawText: Yes, indeed.
units.displayText: Yes, indeed.

spans.text: Yes, indeed.

units.rawText: Thank you, Croque, for always being there for everyone.
units.displayText: Thank you, Croque, for always being there for everyone.

spans.text: Thank you, Croque, for always being there for everyone.

units.rawText: I produce the envelope I had ready, handing it to Croque.
units.displayText: I produce the envelope I had ready, handing it to Croque.

spans.text: I produce the envelope I had ready, handing it to Croque.

units.rawText: Huh? Oh, uh... t-thank you...
units.displayText: Huh? Oh, uh... t-thank you...

spans.text: Huh? Oh, uh... t-thank you...

units.rawText: She takes it into her hand, a light shade of red on her face.
units.displayText: She takes it into her hand, a light shade of red on her face.

spans.text: She takes it into her hand, a light shade of red on her face.

units.rawText: I... I'm not very used to being in this position, but... thank you, Professor...
units.displayText: I... I'm not very used to being in this position, but... thank you, Professor...

spans.text: I... I'm not very used to being in this position, but... thank you, Professor...

units.rawText: Cough.
units.displayText: Cough.

spans.text: Cough.

units.rawText: Croque clears her throat.
units.displayText: Croque clears her throat.

spans.text: Croque clears her throat.

units.rawText: As a gift in return, allow me to introduce to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's variety of secret weapons!
units.displayText: As a gift in return, allow me to introduce to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's variety of secret weapons!

spans.text: As a gift in return, allow me to introduce to you the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's variety of secret weapons!

units.rawText: I've also added the assembly function. Through combining with the train carriage, the stealth bomber, and the underground drill-head...
units.displayText: I've also added the assembly function. Through combining with the train carriage, the stealth bomber, and the underground drill-head...

spans.text: I've also added the assembly function. Through combining with the train carriage, the stealth bomber, and the underground drill-head...

units.rawText: Ahhhh... I've been waiting to say this for so long... final stage, assemble!
units.displayText: Ahhhh... I've been waiting to say this for so long... final stage, assemble!

spans.text: Ahhhh... I've been waiting to say this for so long... final stage, assemble!

units.rawText: Unfortunately, the whole set of mechas is yet to be completed! Or I'd show you without a doubt, Professor!
units.displayText: Unfortunately, the whole set of mechas is yet to be completed! Or I'd show you without a doubt, Professor!

spans.text: Unfortunately, the whole set of mechas is yet to be completed! Or I'd show you without a doubt, Professor!

units.rawText: Um... I can't help but imagine that all of these functions go a bit beyond the original scope of the Nian of legend...
units.displayText: Um... I can't help but imagine that all of these functions go a bit beyond the original scope of the Nian of legend...

spans.text: Um... I can't help but imagine that all of these functions go a bit beyond the original scope of the Nian of legend...

units.rawText: What could you possibly mean, Professor? It's the most common thing a mecha can do, isn't it?
units.displayText: What could you possibly mean, Professor? It's the most common thing a mecha can do, isn't it?

spans.text: What could you possibly mean, Professor? It's the most common thing a mecha can do, isn't it?

units.rawText: That may be so, but... Croque...
units.displayText: That may be so, but... Croque...

spans.text: That may be so, but... Croque...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Is that mecha... under your control right now?
units.displayText: Is that mecha... under your control right now?

spans.text: Is that mecha... under your control right now?

units.rawText: Croque looks in the direction I point at, finding that the previously docile Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's eyes were deathly focused on us.
units.displayText: Croque looks in the direction I point at, finding that the previously docile Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's eyes were deathly focused on us.

spans.text: Croque looks in the direction I point at, finding that the previously docile Super Mecha-Beast "Nian" NOVA's eyes were deathly focused on us.

units.rawText: Uh...
units.displayText: Uh...

spans.text: Uh...

units.rawText: <size=60>ROAR!</size>
units.displayText: ROAR!

spans.text: ROAR!

units.rawText: Oh, not another bug!
units.displayText: Oh, not another bug!

spans.text: Oh, not another bug!

units.rawText: So... the part where it goes rampaging is always there too, huh...
units.displayText: So... the part where it goes rampaging is always there too, huh...

spans.text: So... the part where it goes rampaging is always there too, huh...

units.rawText: With our combined efforts, Croque and I manage to handle the incident before the mecha creates any significant trouble.
units.displayText: With our combined efforts, Croque and I manage to handle the incident before the mecha creates any significant trouble.

spans.text: With our combined efforts, Croque and I manage to handle the incident before the mecha creates any significant trouble.

units.rawText: ...Before you figure out why exactly it happened this time, I'll have to put your Super Mecha-Beast project on hold.
units.displayText: ...Before you figure out why exactly it happened this time, I'll have to put your Super Mecha-Beast project on hold.

spans.text: ...Before you figure out why exactly it happened this time, I'll have to put your Super Mecha-Beast project on hold.

units.rawText: Ehhhh? Alright...
units.displayText: Ehhhh? Alright...

spans.text: Ehhhh? Alright...

units.rawText: ...Seeing as having one's project put on hold... is a common event in a mecha show...
units.displayText: ...Seeing as having one's project put on hold... is a common event in a mecha show...

spans.text: ...Seeing as having one's project put on hold... is a common event in a mecha show...

units.rawText: Ah, are these the mistakes we make in our youth?
units.displayText: Ah, are these the mistakes we make in our youth?

spans.text: Ah, are these the mistakes we make in our youth?

units.rawText: Croque exclaims as she takes apart her Mecha-Beast, piece by piece.
units.displayText: Croque exclaims as she takes apart her Mecha-Beast, piece by piece.

spans.text: Croque exclaims as she takes apart her Mecha-Beast, piece by piece.

units.rawText: No point to repeating those lines now. Get on with your dismantling.
units.displayText: No point to repeating those lines now. Get on with your dismantling.

spans.text: No point to repeating those lines now. Get on with your dismantling.

units.rawText: Okay, okay... right, Professor! Let's go shop for some special supply model kits for the new year!
units.displayText: Okay, okay... right, Professor! Let's go shop for some special supply model kits for the new year!

spans.text: Okay, okay... right, Professor! Let's go shop for some special supply model kits for the new year!

units.rawText: I must fill the mecha-shaped hole in my heart!
units.displayText: I must fill the mecha-shaped hole in my heart!

spans.text: I must fill the mecha-shaped hole in my heart!

units.rawText: As Croque's spirits are swiftly restored, I do not know whether to laugh or cry.
units.displayText: As Croque's spirits are swiftly restored, I do not know whether to laugh or cry.

spans.text: As Croque's spirits are swiftly restored, I do not know whether to laugh or cry.

units.rawText: So long as they don't suddenly start running wild... sure.
units.displayText: So long as they don't suddenly start running wild... sure.

spans.text: So long as they don't suddenly start running wild... sure.
